answer: Locks are written down in ridge, expire in quartz, and meadow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 105 aliases hence needs 123 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1758 identities would post 2953 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
